A refreshed library interface, clearer settings and notices you can act on. Ond now shares its UI toolkit, cover cache and playback engine with Rede, the new audiobook player; the apps keep separate accounts, settings and libraries.

### Downloads

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `Ond-0.5.0-macos-universal.dmg` (or `.zip`) | macOS 11 or later, Apple silicon and Intel |
| `Ond-0.5.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | Linux on x86_64, glibc 2.39 or newer (Ubuntu 24.04, Fedora 40, Debian 13) |
| `Ond-0.5.0-linux-aarch64.tar.gz` | Linux on ARM64, same requirements |
| `Ond-0.5.0-windows-x86_64.zip` | Windows 10 and 11. Still untested on real hardware; issues welcome. |

On Nix: `nix profile install github:Solidsilver/ond/ond-v0.5.0`. [Install instructions](https://github.com/Solidsilver/ond#install).

### Library and layout

- Albums without artwork get generated covers; artists get initials or a mosaic of their albums.
- Track lists and download rows stop at a comfortable reading width in wide windows.
- Album headers separate the release's details from audio measurements.
- Artist pages have Play, Shuffle and a menu.
- The queue toggle shows when repeat is on. Signal and server status use shapes as well as colour.
- Interface zoom in Settings, with ⌘+ / ⌘− / ⌘0 (Ctrl on Linux and Windows).

### Settings and notices

- General settings move into Playback and About; output controls say which way the show/hide button goes.
- Notices can stay on screen when needed, with Retry for failed loads and syncs.
- Undo clearing the queue or removing an entry.

### Under the hood

- Shared widgets now live in the shell toolkit, keeping Ond and Rede's controls consistent.
- The audio engine adds the source-time accounting and speech processing Rede needs; Ond keeps its music playback path.
- Release tags are app-specific: `ond-v0.5.0` for Ond, `rede-v…` for Rede. Ond's update check ignores Rede releases and prereleases.

There is no new Ond library database format in this release, and no manual library rebuild is required.
